Process

How I work

  1. 01

    Discover

    We talk through your goals, your users and how things work today, then agree on what success looks like.

  2. 02

    Design

    Wireframes and designs in Figma, so you can click through the product before any code is written.

  3. 03

    Build

    Working software every week or two on a preview link — React, Next.js, TypeScript and Laravel under the hood.

  4. 04

    Launch & support

    Deployment, SEO, analytics and monitoring, plus fixes and improvements once real users arrive.
